formal_role: Define the vector of quantities the model is allowed to choose
systems_modeling_role: Determine what actions allocations parameters or flows are controllable
review_warning: If variables do not match real decision authority the optimized solution may be unusable

formal_role: Defines what the model minimizes or maximizes
systems_modeling_role: Determines what the model treats as success
review_warning: An objective may be a proxy that excludes important system values or harms

formal_role: Encodes equality inequality balance capacity or feasibility relationships
systems_modeling_role: Defines feasible region of system decisions
review_warning: Missing constraints can make optimized decision infeasible or harmful

formal_role: Defines local sensitivity and update direction
systems_modeling_role: Guides iterative search through parameter or decision space
review_warning: Incorrect gradients or poor scaling can invalidate optimization behavior

formal_role: Use Hessians eigenvalues or singular values to assess objective shape
systems_modeling_role: Explain convergence uniqueness convexity and sensitivity
review_warning: Curvature should be reviewed before trusting solver behavior

formal_role: Measures numerical sensitivity of matrices or solution systems
systems_modeling_role: Determines whether optimized results are stable under perturbation
review_warning: High condition numbers require sensitivity testing and cautious interpretation

formal_role: Adds penalties or constraints to stabilize or structure solutions
systems_modeling_role: Expresses preference for smaller smoother sparse or lower-rank solutions
review_warning: Regularization strength is a modeling choice and should be validated

formal_role: Defines how objectives constraints sensitivity uncertainty and limits are communicated
systems_modeling_role: Prevents optimized results from being overstated as complete system answers
review_warning: An optimum is a model result under assumptions not automatic policy causality or truth
